name: Ig2_LevelSet_LevelSet_LSnodeGeom

This functor actually creates an interaction geom, enabling the interaction to turn real,...

methods.name: normalMismatch
methods.description: Normal orientation mismatch (in radians) of given interaction *cont* if master and slave particles were to be exchanged. Does not support periodic boundary conditions at the moment.
